easy.def: A blue-green color, or a pale blue-green stone.

more.def: A pale blue-green color, or a gemstone of that color.
examples: The sea was a bright aquamarine.
The pool was a pretty aquamarine.

easy.def: A tank for fish, or a place where you can see fish.
examples: We have fish in an aquarium.
I saw sharks at the aquarium.

more.def: A glass tank where fish and other water animals are kept, or a building where many of these tanks are shown to visitors.
examples: We saw jellyfish and sharks on a school trip to the aquarium.
My aquarium at home has six small fish and a snail.
The aquarium cleaned its tanks every week.

easy.def: Living or taking place in water.

more.def: Living in, growing in or taking place in water.
examples: Seals and whales are aquatic mammals.
The aquatic bird dove for food.

more.def: A raised channel or bridge built to carry water over long distances.
examples: The Romans built an aqueduct to bring water to the city.
The aqueduct crossed the valley on tall arches.
